name: v1.106.3
body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **The image-signing key has changed.** Starting with this release, every Docker image and Helm chart is signed with the new cosign key from commit [`e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065). Verifying with the previous key from commit `0112e53` will fail.
>
> Update anything that pins the old `cosign.pub`: `cosign verify` scripts, CI checks, and admission policies such as Kyverno, Sigstore policy-controller or Connaisseur.
>
> New `cosign.pub` SHA-256: `e3fe3e08c44b16407fe0b37c43b4f8b603b3a0f4ee74c29e647bc022d762c2c0`

## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.3
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.106.3

4 PRs. 1 changed, 1 removed. 1 needs action

### Action required

- **Deployment:** Verify image signatures with the `cosign.pub` from commit `e82a3c6`, the previous key no longer matches (#48103) <sup>Also in [1.103.8](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.103.8), [1.104.6](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.104.6), [1.105.4](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.105.4)</sup>

### Changes

- **Deployment:** Removed the eMudhra root CA from every certificate bundle the SDK, proxy and Docker images trust (#47670, #47969, #48139) <sup>Also in [1.103.8](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.103.8), [1.104.6](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.104.6), [1.105.4](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.105.4)</sup>
- **Deployment:** Changed the cosign key that signs Docker images and Helm charts to the one from commit `e82a3c6` (#48103) <sup>Also in [1.103.8](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.103.8), [1.104.6](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.104.6), [1.105.4](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.105.4)</sup>
